item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect Guangdong in the next few days. Tropical Cyclone Yinxing will move across the northern part of the South China Sea and edge closer to the coast of southern China gradually today and tomorrow. Under the combined effect of Yinxing and the monsoon, it will be windy with a few squally showers over the coastal areas over the weekend. Seas will be rough with swells. With Yinxing turning southwestwards gradually on Sunday, departing the coastal areas and weakening, the weather will improve over the region in the following couple of days. Besides, the broad area of low pressure to the seas east of the Philippines will move towards the vicinity of Luzon in the next couple of days. However, there are rather large uncertainties in its development and movement.
